scene: You climb onto the neon rooftop dance floor under swirling spotlights.
picture: Along a flat rooftop line, the silver-haired boy in a mint-green hoodie with dance bag stands centre-left by a yellow roof hatch. On the left sits a glowing synthesiser console. In the centre, a chrome robot poses mid-freeze. Far right, an anchored zipline cable stretches toward distant neon signs.
shown: an unattended glowing synthesiser console humming on the left
a chrome robot frozen mid-spin in the centre
a taut cable on the right running down to a ramen stall

variants.scene: You pop up onto a breezy rooftop party lit by crisscrossing beam lights.
The crowd claps along as colourful spotlights crisscross above the rooftop dance circle.
You emerge under glowing party bulbs, still wondering where {quest} might be hidden.
